title: Two implementations of a query, or one
description: Where a grid's sorting, filtering and grouping are written in JavaScript, a data set that outgrows the browser needs the same rules written a second time in the backend, and the two have to be kept in agreement by hand. In opengrid the element hands a query as JSON to one engine written in Rust. That engine is compiled to WebAssembly for the tab and natively into opengrid-server, where it can also hand parts of the query to PostgreSQL. Shared conformance cases check every path.
